tagline: Grounded, order-aware AI support for your store
intro: AI support that answers only from your store content. It handles order requests and cuts tickets.
details: Busymate AI adds an AI support assistant to your online store. It answers shoppers using only your own products, policies and store content, shows its sources, and says when it is not sure instead of guessing. Signed-in shoppers can check order status and tracking and ask to update, cancel, return or refund an order; each action is confirmed first, and larger refunds or low-confidence conversations are handed to your team. It replies in the shopper's language, including right-to-left scripts.
feature_bullets: Answers only from your own products, policies and store content, with sources
Says when it is not sure and offers a human instead of guessing
Signed-in shoppers get order status, tracking and confirmed order actions
Cancellations, returns and refunds are confirmed first; larger refunds go to you
Replies in the shopper's own language, including right-to-left scripts
pricing_summary: Monthly plans with included AI resolutions, then a per-resolution charge up to your monthly spend cap. Free plan available; paid plans start with a 14-day free trial.
